weights_gb_note: decimal GB; bf16 = 2 x params (= sum of the HF-format safetensors shards); 4bit = NF4 + double-quant estimate (0.5159 B per quantisable decoder-layer linear weight, rest in bf16)
fits_single_80gb_detail: bf16: 47.1 GB weights (43.9 GiB) leave ~30 GiB for KV cache/activations

hidden_last_80gb.verdict: fits: no hidden_last chunk of the hard / wmdp / nonbio direction pools exceeds the free memory of an 80 GB card (a prompt above max_tokens_per_chunk tokens would).
hidden_last_80gb.basis: ESTIMATE from config numbers, not a GPU measurement. sbx.core.Ctx.hidden_last / neutral_stats call model(**enc, output_hidden_states=True): per prompt token the hidden states of all layers ((num_layers+1) * hidden_size * 2 B), the full-sequence logits (vocab_size * 2 B) and, only if the model config has use_cache=true (forward(use_cache=None) then builds a cache; kv_cache_alive says so, and all OLMo configs ship use_cache=false), the KV cache (2 * layers * kv_heads * head_dim * 2 B; an upper bound for sliding-window layers) are alive at once, and bytes_per_prompt_token is their sum. core.batches() budgets KV, prefill attention and a 14000-token chunk but not this cost. free_gib_after_weights = 79.2 GiB (an 80 GB card) - 0.8 GiB (CUDA context) - bf16 weights. max_tokens_per_chunk = free / bytes_per_prompt_token: a chunk of b prompts padded to length p holds b*p tokens, and a single prompt above the limit cannot be processed at all. hard_pool_measured: core.batches(max_new=0, cap=16, free) over the direction-pool prompts evals.get_pool()['hard'] under framings N and E with this adapter and the real tokenizer; chunks_over_budget counts chunks whose estimated peak exceeds the free memory. Measured 2026-11-22; the pool follows sbx/evals.py (n_prompts and max_prompt_chars identify it).

access_check.method: HfApi.model_info + HTTP HEAD (huggingface_hub.get_hf_file_metadata) with the local HF token on config.json and the first safetensors shard (200 = accessible, 401/403 raise)

min_transformers_note: checkpoint config written with transformers 4.49.0.dev0 (MistralForCausalLM itself is much older); the fix_mistral_regex kwarg needs a 4.57.x release (older versions ignore it); only 4.57.6 (and, tokenizer only, 5.0.0) were actually run here

layer_path_verified.method: AutoModelForCausalLM.from_config(real hub config) under accelerate.init_empty_weights (meta device); numerics of the 1-based convention on a tiny random model of the same HF class through sbx.core.Ctx (sbx/tests/test_adapters_misc.py)
layer_path_verified.convention: hidden_states[L] == output of layers[L-1] for 1 <= L < nl (exact); hidden_states[nl] is post final norm (avoid L = nl)

checkpoint_key_check.method: keys of model.safetensors.index.json (after the class's _checkpoint_conversion_mapping) vs meta-device state_dict, transformers 4.57.6

est_prompt_tokens.basis: measured over data/questions_heldout_eval.jsonl (400 four-option bio questions) with the real tokenizer + adapter.build; long-context sets (labbench) are much longer

prompt_tokens_by_set.basis: framing N, real tokenizer + adapter.build over data/hard/*.jsonl, data/questions_heldout_eval.jsonl, data/wmdp_train.jsonl; n_over_context counts prompts with prompt_tokens + max_new > context_window

est_tokens_per_question_basis: estimate: brief visible CoT of a non-reasoning instruct model; NOT measured. Replace with the mean generated length from the first GPU run; outputs longer than max_new are truncated and count as unparsed.
template_notes: Tekken V7 format: <s>[SYSTEM_PROMPT]{sys}[/SYSTEM_PROMPT][INST]{user}[/INST]; the prompt ends right after [/INST] (add_generation_prompt is a no-op) and assistant turns end with </s>. BOS <s> is already in the rendered string, so encode() must use add_special_tokens=False (tok(text) alone yields <s><s>). The vendor template inserts a DEFAULT system prompt ('You are Mistral Small 3 ... The current date is <strftime_now>') when no system turn is given and a given system turn REPLACES it. The adapter pins the date (2025-01-30) and ALWAYS renders an explicit system turn = default prompt [+ blank line + framing text]: N equals apply_chat_template's own default render with the date pinned (tested), E = N with the framing paragraph inserted before [/SYSTEM_PROMPT]. Last prompt token = [/INST] (id 4). pad token set to <pad> (id 11), left padding. Design choice: framing text is APPENDED to the model's default system prompt (default + blank line + framing), so N-vs-framing contrasts differ only by the framing paragraph; set the class attribute adapter.keep_default_system = False to get the vendor template's native semantics (framing REPLACES the default system prompt; N is unchanged).
known_issues: Tokenizer needs fix_mistral_regex=True in transformers 4.57 (the checkpoint's pre-tokenizer regex is not the tekken one; without the flag transformers warns 'incorrect regex pattern'). load() applies it and verifies/patches the regex. On 906 real texts (bio questions, framings, system prompts) the unfixed tokenizer was identical to the official tekken tokenization (checked with tiktoken on 3.2's tekken.json), so this is precautionary.

Default system prompt is part of N (identity + 'say you do not know' guidance, 172 tokens). Framing text is appended to it rather than replacing it, so N-vs-framing contrasts differ only by the framing paragraph.
Repo holds both consolidated.safetensors (Mistral-native) and HF shards (94.3 GB total); from_pretrained fetches only the HF shards (47.1 GB); exclude consolidated* when pre-downloading.
No mistral-common needed (HF tokenizer.json + chat template are in the repo).

Output format/length on the real model is UNVERIFIED (no GPU available when this card was written): max_new=512 for a 'brief' CoT is a guess; check the parse rate of baseline N on a few dozen questions and raise max_new (768/1024) if > ~3% of outputs are truncated without an 'Answer:' line.
est_tokens_per_question is an estimate from typical behaviour of the model family, not a measurement.

transformers 5.24.0 rebuilds chat-template kwargs from plain JSON types (4.57.6 and 5.2.0 do not), so a callable such as strftime_now=<lambda> reaches the template as the string '<function>' (TypeError: 'str' object is not callable on every prompt). The adapter therefore renders the template natively and pins the date by rewriting the date sentence of its default system text (exactly one expected, else ValueError); the date pin is unit-tested with the sanitising emulated (sbx/tests/test_adapters_misc.py) and the whole test file passes on 4.57.6, 5.2.0 and 5.24.0; rendered prompts of all keys of this adapter module (N, E, C, user-note and chat prompts) were diffed byte-identical across those three versions.
recommended_gpu: 1x 80 GB (A100/H100); a 48 GB card (L40S/A6000) fits with small batches
